data.name: Sync.E2e.Acknowledge
data.value: I understand that if I forget this passphrase, my encrypted notes cannot be recovered.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Banner.Blocked
data.value: Your notes are end to end encrypted and locked. Use your passkey to unlock them: the hardware PRF key your passkey provides is essential to keeping your data secure, so they cannot be read or synced without it.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Banner.NeedsPasskeyAndSetup
data.value: Your notes are end to end encrypted. Use your passkey, then set up this device with your passphrase to read and sync them.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Banner.NeedsSetup
data.value: Your notes are end to end encrypted. Set up this device with your passphrase to read and sync them.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Dialog.ChangePassphrase.Text
data.value: Your notes and other devices are not affected. Use the new passphrase when you next set up a device.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Dialog.Disable.Text
data.value: Every note will be decrypted on this device, then synced unencrypted. Your keys are deleted, and other devices turn encryption off when they next start.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Dialog.Enable.Text
data.value: Your notes will be encrypted on this device before they are synced. Other devices need this passphrase once to be set up.

data.name: Sync.E2e.NoRecoveryWarning
data.value: There is no passphrase recovery. If you forget your passphrase, nobody can decrypt your notes, including us.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Resolve.Text1
data.value: End to end encryption was turned off on another device, so your notes there were decrypted and synced unencrypted.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Resolve.Text2
data.value: This device will decrypt its own changes that have not been synced yet, forget its keys, then sync, which brings down the decrypted notes.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Status.NeedsSetup
data.value: On, but this device has not been set up yet. Enter your passphrase to read and sync your notes here.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Status.Unlocked
data.value: On. Your notes are encrypted on this device before they are synced.

data.name: Sync.E2e.Step.CheckIndex
data.value: Check no notes are already encrypted

data.name: Sync.E2e.Step.DecryptFiles
data.value: Decrypt your notes

data.name: Sync.E2e.Step.EncryptFiles
data.value: Encrypt your notes

data.name: Sync.E2e.Step.Sync
data.value: Sync every note to this device

data.name: Sync.E2e.Text
data.value: Encrypts your notes on this device with a key only you hold, so they are synced and stored encrypted. It needs your passkey and a passphrase of your own.

data.name: Sync.Folder.Banner
data.value: Your notes are kept in the folder {0}. Allow access to it again to use them and sync.

data.name: Sync.Folder.NotKept
data.value: The browser did not keep access to the folder. Try again, or move your notes to browser storage in Settings.

data.name: Sync.Settings.Text
data.value: Your notes are kept in this browser and synced with your cloud storage when you are online.

data.name: Sync.StartOff.Help
data.value: Use your notes on this device without syncing them with the cloud. Changes sync when you turn sync back on.

data.name: Sync.Storage.Dialog.Title
data.value: Move your notes?

data.name: Sync.Storage.Location.Text
data.value: Where your notes are kept on this device. Sync pauses while they are moved.

data.name: Sync.Storage.MovingInAnotherTab
data.value: Your notes are being moved to another storage in another tab. This tab reloads when it finishes.
